relevance_note: Case report of a family in which the proband and his father carry a heterozygous TNFAIP3 deletion: "患儿及其父亲检出肿瘤坏死因子α诱导蛋白3（TNFAIP3）基因外显子2~9杂合缺失".
method_note: Paper is in Chinese with no tables in the Markdown; everything comes from my reading of the prose. A Python script in my scratch directory assembled the JSON from spans I chose by hand and checked that every span occurs verbatim, every row has every schema field, and enum values are valid. No table transcription was involved. LABELS: the paper gives pedigree labels only for the proband (Ⅲ-4) and his father (Ⅱ-4). The proband's mother is not labelled in the text (pedigree figure not available), so she has the descriptive label "proband's mother". She was tested (WES of proband and both parents), but the CNV was reported only in the proband and father; the paper never states her result explicitly, so she has no variant row. People from previously published reports who are described individually in the Discussion have their own rows, labelled with the paper's own words: the patient of 尹美娜等［6］ (same exon 2-9 deletion), the one adult-onset patient of 文献［7］, the girl of Zhang等［9］ and her asymptomatic carrier mother, and two brothers (弟弟, 哥哥) from the Japanese national survey ［20］. The 19 CNV cases summarised in Supplementary Table 1 (附表1) are not in the Markdown, so no other literature cases are extracted. Group statements were not used to exclude anything: "家系中其他成员无发热、腹泻、腹痛、口腔溃疡、关节炎等临床表现，但未进行基因检测" names no individuals (and the mother was tested, so it does not clearly cover her), and the 19-case counts name no one. DECISIONS: inheritance is "not reported" for Ⅲ-4 because the paper never states the origin of the deletion, although the parental testing statement records that the father carries it; the same applies to the Zhang girl, whose mother carries the variant. qPCR confirmation of the deletion ("qPCR检测各外显子相对表达量，结果见图3") is described only via Figure 3 and was treated as molecular confirmation, not functional evidence. The authors' ACMG reasoning is given as points ①-④ without criterion codes, so acmg_criteria is "not reported". Zygosity of the 尹美娜 patient is recorded as heterozygous only because the paper says that patient has the same variant as this family ("与文献［6］报道的HA20患儿具有相同变异"). The father's ESR 28 mm/1 h, CRP 9.67 mg/L, WBC 7.64×10^9/L and fecal calprotectin 176 μg/g are reported without interpretation or adult reference ranges, so I made no phenotype rows for them and left "elevated inflammatory markers" as not reported. Perianal ulcers (proband; 尹美娜 patient) were not mapped to the "genital ulcers" checklist item, though the Discussion groups them as "肛周/生殖器溃疡". Anaemia in the proband is not described as autoimmune, so "cytopenia (autoimmune)" is not reported. The 哥哥's "严重神经系统症状" does not specify central nervous system, so that checklist item is not reported. The Zhang mother's "无临床症状" is recorded as one excluded row; checklist items are left not reported because the statement is not feature-specific. TIME-POINT FINDINGS, not treated as contradictions: for Ⅲ-4, "口腔黏膜未见溃疡" at the admission examination, against a history of recurrent oral ulcers from age 3; and "未见溃疡" at the follow-up colonoscopy after treatment, against colorectal ulcers at diagnosis. Both are recorded as excluded rows, with the timing in severity_or_detail, and the checklist keeps "observed". DISCREPANCY: for Ⅱ-4, gastroscopy says chronic NON-atrophic gastritis with erosion ("慢性非萎缩性胃炎伴糜烂") but pathology says mild chronic ATROPHIC gastritis with intestinal metaplasia ("轻度慢性萎缩性胃炎伴轻度肠化"); both are recorded. Reference ［9］ (Zhang) is cited among the CNV cases ［6-19］, but the Zhang patient described in the text has a nonsense variant (c.1300_1301delinsTA, p.A434*); this is not necessarily a contradiction. Proband age 3岁4个月 is his age at presentation (2024-01-11); he was then followed for 1.5 years with no age stated, so age_at_last_evaluation may be an underestimate. The first author is not printed in the Markdown.
